decisions.reason: As a large-firm extension very close to the core reusable-packaging business in a growing industry, this product likely meets or is near aspiration levels and the firm has enough slack to continue it.

Because the valve builds directly on the established bulk-container line and was given a dedicated market page, management would likely see no strong performance shortfall and keep it as a complementary offer.

The take-back service is less visibly established and more uncertain, but its strong fit with the firm's move toward sustainable service-based packaging and the slack of a large firm make continued trial more likely than withdrawal.
